say:1:1035232001:1.text: Yes, only a handful of people have ever seen them.
say:1:1035232001:1.source_cn: 是的，非常少，几乎从没有人见过他们。
say:1:1035232001:1.male: Yes, only a handful of people have ever seen them.
say:1:1035232001:1.female: Yes, only a handful of people have ever seen them.

say:2:1035232002:1.text: But a Celestial has recently been spotted here at the Moon Temple!
say:2:1035232002:1.source_cn: 但是最近半神出现了！就在这里，月神殿！
say:2:1035232002:1.male: But a Celestial has recently been spotted here at the Moon Temple!
say:2:1035232002:1.female: But a Celestial has recently been spotted here at the Moon Temple!

say:3:1035232003:1.text: I heard this Celestial loves music, which is why I've written this song. I wish to meet him in person for my research.
say:3:1035232003:1.source_cn: 我听说这位半神喜爱音乐，所以特意准备了这首曲子，希望能...
